targets.why: The base garments are the MINIMUM coverage every later item must hide. So the base top ends at the natural waist (tops may be waist-length, not t-shirt-length), the base shorts end at mid-thigh (shorts and skirts may be that short), and the neckline is a moderate round neck. The ranges also keep both base garments inside Northstar's own tee and jeans, so D-197's three default items can dress the new base back into the original Northstar look (BF15).

baseClothingStrategy.rule: The base garments are AUTHORING MATERIAL ONLY. They define the mandatory minimum coverage of the top and bottom categories and are never shipped or shown.
baseClothingStrategy.runtime: The runtime body layer leaves the base garments' regions EMPTY (transparent). Every outfit must contain a top and a bottom whose opaque pixels cover the base top and base shorts regions (plus 1 px) completely; the resolver renders complete-or-null, so a figure without them never renders.
baseClothingStrategy.hidden: Under every top and bottom: the top covers the base top, the bottom covers the base shorts.
baseClothingStrategy.replaced: There is nothing to replace at runtime: the base garments are absent, the item takes their place.
baseClothingStrategy.extraction: During item extraction the base figure WITH its base garments is the 'behind' picture, so an item is measured against exactly what it must hide.

visualCriteria: V1 The same character: Northstar's painted style, line weight, soft shading and colours; the figure reads as Northstar without clothes over it, not as a new drawing style.
V2 Child-friendly and neutral: no nudity, no anatomical detail, no navel, no muscle definition, no body emphasis; the base garments read as plain sportswear.
V3 Natural joins at neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles: no seams, steps, colour breaks or doubled outlines where reconstructed skin meets the original.
V4 Proportions consistent with the clothed Northstar: limbs neither thinner nor thicker than the clothing implies; both sides symmetric where Northstar is.
V5 Hands and feet in Northstar's style; simple stylised toes; feet flat on the ground line.
V6 Base garments plain: one colour each, no logos, text, patterns, folds or decoration.
V7 At app sizes (hub 110×165, quiz 52×78) the figure reads cleanly; no halo, no fringe on the real surface.
V8 Dressed back in D-197's default items, it is visually the original Northstar.
automaticVersusVisual: BF1–BF15 are automatic and binding; a fail rejects the candidate, and nothing is retouched to pass them. V1–V8 need the owner's eyes; the gates cannot judge style, anatomy, child-appropriateness or the quality of a join, and a pass on BF never substitutes for them.

recompositionD201.rule: For a GENERATED body the candidate owns its neck below the seam: the body layer is the candidate's pixels below y 440 (empty under the opaque head), and where the head stack only carries its leftover collar edge — the bald head's antialiased pixels and a 3 px band of nearly opaque pixels above its lower boundary, with no hair over them — the candidate's own pixel is the figure. D-194's FG.bodyLayer stays unchanged for Northstar itself.
recompositionD201.why: D-200 §4: the head stack's lower neck rows carry Northstar's skin-to-collar blend baked into their colour (e.g. 251,206,136 against 254,195,127 at alpha 254); over a continuous generated neck they draw a pale dotted line. Measured on A: 126 line px with the D-194 rule, 0 with the D-201 rule; the raw image has none.
recompositionD201.effectOnA: none on the verdicts: every BF1–BF15 verdict is identical with either rule (D-201 diagnosis)

P-BF4-BARE-FEET.replaces: BF4's ground part for BARE feet (centre axis and hands unchanged)
P-BF4-BARE-FEET.rule: each bare sole lies between the top of Northstar's sneaker outsole (17 light rows above the ground line, measured) and the ground line, i.e. y 1471–1488, and ≤ 0.5 % of the foot lies outside the sneaker + jeans silhouette (+2 px)
P-BF4-BARE-FEET.why: BF4 compared a bare foot with the BOTTOM of a sneaker's outsole (±4 px). A bare foot inside a shoe stands on the insole, not under it: a foot whose sole is 7 px above the ground line is hidden by every sneaker and leaves room for a sandal sole.
P-BF4-BARE-FEET.consequence: a barefoot view (deferred O3) would stand up to 17 px above shod figures; shoe items keep the ground line ±4

P-BF9-CHEST-BAND.replaces: BF9's coverage band (colour and hem parts unchanged)
P-BF9-CHEST-BAND.rule: the band is the candidate's OWN torso, 4 px rim excluded, from 8 px below its armpits to the natural waist + 4 px; ≥ 99.5 % opaque, non-skin
P-BF9-CHEST-BAND.why: BF9's band was the t-shirt's columns from 60 px below the shoulders: it includes the shoulder skin a sleeveless top intentionally shows above the armpit, and the antialiased rim of a close-fitting torso that is narrower than the t-shirt. On A: 166 skin px above the armpit (armholes), 467 semi-transparent and 51 transparent rim px beside a narrower torso; 0 skin below the armpit.
P-BF9-CHEST-BAND.consequence: a top must still cover the chest from the armpits to the waist; armholes above the armpit become allowed

P-BF14-ALPHA.rule: measured AFTER the project's established deterministic dust cleanup (cleanAlpha: alpha < 24 AND orphan-soft — D-112/D-115, applied to H1 by D-131): total semi-transparent share ≤ 6 % AND interior share (> 2 px from transparency) ≤ 1 %
P-BF14-ALPHA.why: A's 7.79 % is 19,330 px of invisible encoder dust (alpha < 24); after the cleanup it is 2.06 % (Northstar 1.94 %) with an interior of 16 px (Northstar 23), and the edges look clean on white, near-black, magenta and grey. A single share also let a real interior fault pass: a translucent 60×60 patch passes BF14 but fails P-BF14.
P-BF14-ALPHA.consequence: the cleanup becomes a documented step of the post-processing (it removes only invisible dust and is reported); a soft fringe or translucent interior still fails
